notes: You can now actually reposition a landscape background. Before, a wide (landscape) video or image dropped into the portrait frame was centre-cropped, and the X/Y sliders could only slide that centre slice around — they could never reach the left or right of the source. Now X/Y choose which part of the video shows (drag X left to focus the left side, e.g. a shop on the edge of the shot), and Scale zooms toward that same spot. The X/Y sliders are labelled with arrows so the direction is clear. Works for both video and image backgrounds, in the preview and the final render.
